title.en: Chapter 18 — The Old Man of the Sea

book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: الموج رماني على جزيرة فيها شجر وفواكه ونهر.
sentences.en: The waves threw me onto an island with trees and fruit and a river.

sentences.ar: وقلت: الحمد لله، هاي أحسن من كل اللي قبلها.
sentences.en: And I said: praise God, this is better than all before it.

sentences.ar: وبعد يوم، لقيت عند النهر رجل كبير بالعمر، قاعد.
sentences.en: And after a day, I found by the river an old man, sitting.
Thin, and weak, dressed in leaves.

sentences.ar: وأشر لي بإيده على الجهة التانية من النهر.
sentences.en: And he gestured to me toward the other side of the river.
As if he wanted to cross.
I said: poor man.
I will carry him.
I put him on my shoulders, and crossed the river.
And on the other side, I bent so he could get down.
He did not get down.
He wound his legs around my neck, and squeezed.

sentences.ar: إجرين زي الجلد الأسود، قاسية، وقوية زي الحديد.
sentences.en: Legs like black leather, hard, and strong as iron.
I could not breathe, and fell to the ground.

sentences.ar: وهو ضرب على راسي بإيده، وأشر: قوم.
sentences.en: And he struck my head with his hand, and gestured: get up.
Walk.
And I walked.

sentences.ar: من الصبح للمسا، وهو على كتافي، وإجريه حول رقبتي.
sentences.en: From morning to evening, him on my shoulders, his legs around my neck.
Every time I stopped, he squeezed.
Every time I slowed, he struck.

sentences.ar: وكان ياكل من الشجر وهو فوقي، ويبول عليّ، وينام على كتافي.
sentences.en: And he ate from the trees while on me, and relieved himself on me, and slept on my shoulders.
And even asleep, his legs did not loosen.
Days.
And then weeks.

sentences.ar: وصرت زي حمار، وهو صاحب الحمار.
sentences.en: And I became like a donkey, and he the donkey's owner.

sentences.ar: وفكرت: من كل الموت اللي شفته، هاد الأسوأ.
sentences.en: And I thought: of all the deaths I have seen, this is the worst.
The porter said: and why?
He was not killing you.

sentences.ar: قال السندباد: لأنه ما كان بيقتلني.
sentences.en: Sindbad said: because he was not killing me.
The giant eats you and it is over.
The snake swallows you and it is over.

sentences.ar: بس هاد، كان بده إياني أعيش، عشانه.
sentences.en: But this one wanted me to live, for his sake.

sentences.ar: كل يوم، لحد ما أموت من التعب.
sentences.en: Every day, until I died of exhaustion.

sentences.ar: وشفت تحت الشجر عظام ناس، وفهمت إنهم كانوا قبلي.
sentences.en: And I saw under the trees the bones of men, and understood they had been before me.
Old donkeys of the Old Man of the Sea.
